meta.title: Prelude to Judgment
meta.description: Once we were of one mind, but now we are of different paths.

units.rawText:
"Die; for my part I will accept my fate whensoever Jove and the other gods see fit to send it."
- The Iliad, Book XXII

units.rawText: >> CHAPTER 14 // PHOTOLUMINESCENCE...
units.displayText: >> CHAPTER 14 // PHOTOLUMINESCENCE...

units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, Plaza of Oaths

units.rawText: A flock of white birds take flight, accompanied by the tolling of a great bell.
units.displayText: A flock of white birds take flight, accompanied by the tolling of a great bell.

spans.text: A flock of white birds take flight, accompanied by the tolling of a great bell.

units.rawText: Upon the stele-adorned plaza, young Sanctifiers stand at attention, their two leaders at the center of their gazes.
units.displayText: Upon the stele-adorned plaza, young Sanctifiers stand at attention, their two leaders at the center of their gazes.

spans.text: Upon the stele-adorned plaza, young Sanctifiers stand at attention, their two leaders at the center of their gazes.

units.rawText: ...We are gathered here to mourn those of the vanguard, those who gave their lives in the assault on Tartarus.
units.displayText: ...We are gathered here to mourn those of the vanguard, those who gave their lives in the assault on Tartarus.

spans.text: ...We are gathered here to mourn those of the vanguard, those who gave their lives in the assault on Tartarus.

units.rawText: Atlas, Electra, Alcyone, Eos. They walked the path of duty; as true Sanctifiers until their final moments. Their names shall be recorded upon these steles as proof of their bravery.
units.displayText: Atlas, Electra, Alcyone, Eos. They walked the path of duty; as true Sanctifiers until their final moments. Their names shall be recorded upon these steles as proof of their bravery.

spans.text: Atlas, Electra, Alcyone, Eos. They walked the path of duty; as true Sanctifiers until their final moments. Their names shall be recorded upon these steles as proof of their bravery.

units.rawText: Fallen in Tartarus they may be, their efforts and courage shall never be forgotten.
units.displayText: Fallen in Tartarus they may be, their efforts and courage shall never be forgotten.

spans.text: Fallen in Tartarus they may be, their efforts and courage shall never be forgotten.

units.rawText: Thus, as newly-born Sanctifiers, heed my words: To protect Magrasea is your duty. Before our elevated ideals are made reality, we ought to keep your beliefs close to heart and carry out our duty, lest we forget the oaths we once made.
units.displayText: Thus, as newly-born Sanctifiers, heed my words: To protect Magrasea is your duty. Before our elevated ideals are made reality, we ought to keep your beliefs close to heart and carry out our duty, lest we forget the oaths we once made.

spans.text: Thus, as newly-born Sanctifiers, heed my words: To protect Magrasea is your duty. Before our elevated ideals are made reality, we ought to keep your beliefs close to heart and carry out our duty, lest we forget the oaths we once made.

units.rawText: Eosphorus takes a step forward, beginning to draw a star on his forehead to begin the mantra. A reinvigorated musical accompaniment begins and the Sanctifiers beneath the podium begin to chant in their impassioned state.
units.displayText: Eosphorus takes a step forward, beginning to draw a star on his forehead to begin the mantra. A reinvigorated musical accompaniment begins and the Sanctifiers beneath the podium begin to chant in their impassioned state.

spans.text: Eosphorus takes a step forward, beginning to draw a star on his forehead to begin the mantra. A reinvigorated musical accompaniment begins and the Sanctifiers beneath the podium begin to chant in their impassioned state.

units.rawText: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: ...We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

units.rawText: Detecting her partner's absent-minded state, Angelus swipes at Eucharist's hair with her wings.
units.displayText: Detecting her partner's absent-minded state, Angelus swipes at Eucharist's hair with her wings.

spans.text: Detecting her partner's absent-minded state, Angelus swipes at Eucharist's hair with her wings.

units.rawText: (Eucharist, our oaths.)
units.displayText: Eucharist, our oaths.

spans.text: Eucharist, our oaths.

units.displayText: Man...

spans.text: Man...

units.rawText: The girl unwillingly retracts her gaze, pouting in the direction she was just looking in.
units.displayText: The girl unwillingly retracts her gaze, pouting in the direction she was just looking in.

spans.text: The girl unwillingly retracts her gaze, pouting in the direction she was just looking in.

units.rawText: (These rituals are so boring. Oh, look, Big Sis Angelus.)
units.displayText: These rituals are so boring. Oh, look, Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: These rituals are so boring. Oh, look, Big Sis Angelus.

units.rawText: (Isn't Lord Eosphorus not following along either?)
units.displayText: Isn't Lord Eosphorus not following along either?

spans.text: Isn't Lord Eosphorus not following along either?

units.rawText: The silver-haired leader does not look at these newborn Sanctifiers, instead casting his gaze towards the masses of steles that signify the Sanctifiers' glory.
units.displayText: The silver-haired leader does not look at these newborn Sanctifiers, instead casting his gaze towards the masses of steles that signify the Sanctifiers' glory.

spans.text: The silver-haired leader does not look at these newborn Sanctifiers, instead casting his gaze towards the masses of steles that signify the Sanctifiers' glory.

units.rawText: The names of the sacrificed are carved upon them by their creator. Most of these inscriptions are now worn with the passing of time and only the few newest names towards the bottom remain almost blindingly visible.
units.displayText: The names of the sacrificed are carved upon them by their creator. Most of these inscriptions are now worn with the passing of time and only the few newest names towards the bottom remain almost blindingly visible.

spans.text: The names of the sacrificed are carved upon them by their creator. Most of these inscriptions are now worn with the passing of time and only the few newest names towards the bottom remain almost blindingly visible.

units.rawText: The black-haired Sanctifier leader next to him finishes his vows with eyes closed, looking towards the back-turned figure of Eosphorus.
units.displayText: The black-haired Sanctifier leader next to him finishes his vows with eyes closed, looking towards the back-turned figure of Eosphorus.

spans.text: The black-haired Sanctifier leader next to him finishes his vows with eyes closed, looking towards the back-turned figure of Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Hesitating for a moment, he does not walk forward, only offering a quiet reminder.
units.displayText: Hesitating for a moment, he does not walk forward, only offering a quiet reminder.

spans.text: Hesitating for a moment, he does not walk forward, only offering a quiet reminder.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, do not forget our duties as Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, do not forget our duties as Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Eosphorus, do not forget our duties as Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Our duties... you're right.
units.displayText: Our duties... you're right.

spans.text: Our duties... you're right.

units.rawText: His tranquil gaze sweeps across the masses before him. After a brief pause, Eosphorus completes his portion of his work.
units.displayText: His tranquil gaze sweeps across the masses before him. After a brief pause, Eosphorus completes his portion of his work.

spans.text: His tranquil gaze sweeps across the masses before him. After a brief pause, Eosphorus completes his portion of his work.

units.rawText: May we carry the will of the deceased with us. As we bear our burden, fight! For Magrasea!
units.displayText: May we carry the will of the deceased with us. As we bear our burden, fight! For Magrasea!

spans.text: May we carry the will of the deceased with us. As we bear our burden, fight! For Magrasea!

units.rawText: <size=60>For Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: For Magrasea!

spans.text: For Magrasea!

units.rawText: In stark contrast to the fervor beneath the podium, Eosphorus stands silently in place, seemingly thinking of something while also arriving at a resolution.
units.displayText: In stark contrast to the fervor beneath the podium, Eosphorus stands silently in place, seemingly thinking of something while also arriving at a resolution.

spans.text: In stark contrast to the fervor beneath the podium, Eosphorus stands silently in place, seemingly thinking of something while also arriving at a resolution.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' erratic behavior was all too obvious to Hesperus, but regrettably he is not a man who oft speaks his mind. Those who Eosphorus can pour his heart out to are long gone, left behind in Tartarus.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' erratic behavior was all too obvious to Hesperus, but regrettably he is not a man who oft speaks his mind. Those who Eosphorus can pour his heart out to are long gone, left behind in Tartarus.

spans.text: Eosphorus' erratic behavior was all too obvious to Hesperus, but regrettably he is not a man who oft speaks his mind. Those who Eosphorus can pour his heart out to are long gone, left behind in Tartarus.

units.rawText: That's it for the ceremony. Good work, Eosphorus. Leave the rest to me.
units.displayText: That's it for the ceremony. Good work, Eosphorus. Leave the rest to me.

spans.text: That's it for the ceremony. Good work, Eosphorus. Leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Eosphorus?

spans.text: Eosphorus?

units.rawText: He does not respond, turning and hiding himself within the deep darkness behind the veil. The new generation of Sanctifiers still exclaim their ideals, hot blood flowing in their veins.
units.displayText: He does not respond, turning and hiding himself within the deep darkness behind the veil. The new generation of Sanctifiers still exclaim their ideals, hot blood flowing in their veins.

spans.text: He does not respond, turning and hiding himself within the deep darkness behind the veil. The new generation of Sanctifiers still exclaim their ideals, hot blood flowing in their veins.

units.rawText: <size=40>Aye, aye! For Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: Aye, aye! For Magrasea!

spans.text: Aye, aye! For Magrasea!

units.rawText: <size=40>Well said! For Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: Well said! For Magrasea!

spans.text: Well said! For Magrasea!

units.rawText: Shush! Lord Hesperus is still on the podium, you really must quiet down!
units.displayText: Shush! Lord Hesperus is still on the podium, you really must quiet down!

spans.text: Shush! Lord Hesperus is still on the podium, you really must quiet down!

units.rawText: Faith, come help me stop them.
units.displayText: Faith, come help me stop them.

spans.text: Faith, come help me stop them.

units.rawText: For... Magrasea.
units.displayText: For... Magrasea.

spans.text: For... Magrasea.

units.rawText: You too, huh...
units.displayText: You too, huh...

spans.text: You too, huh...

units.rawText: More and more begin to join the chant. The thunderous proclaiming reverbs through the courtyard, the sound rushing towards the heavens.
units.displayText: More and more begin to join the chant. The thunderous proclaiming reverbs through the courtyard, the sound rushing towards the heavens.

spans.text: More and more begin to join the chant. The thunderous proclaiming reverbs through the courtyard, the sound rushing towards the heavens.

units.rawText: For a holy place to be sullied with such desecrating clamor... Lord Hesperus, shall I go with Crime to put an end to this?
units.displayText: For a holy place to be sullied with such desecrating clamor... Lord Hesperus, shall I go with Crime to put an end to this?

spans.text: For a holy place to be sullied with such desecrating clamor... Lord Hesperus, shall I go with Crime to put an end to this?

units.rawText: Let's not, Punishment. They have committed no transgression.
units.displayText: Let's not, Punishment. They have committed no transgression.

spans.text: Let's not, Punishment. They have committed no transgression.

units.rawText: Silence, Crime! Who do you stand with, exactly?
units.displayText: Silence, Crime! Who do you stand with, exactly?

spans.text: Silence, Crime! Who do you stand with, exactly?

units.rawText: I simply do not enjoy baring blades against our own...
units.displayText: I simply do not enjoy baring blades against our own...

spans.text: I simply do not enjoy baring blades against our own...

units.rawText: Sighing, Crime only speaks with their eyes.
units.displayText: Sighing, Crime only speaks with their eyes.

spans.text: Sighing, Crime only speaks with their eyes.

units.rawText: ...Let them be.
units.displayText: ...Let them be.

spans.text: ...Let them be.

units.rawText: Hesperus looks towards the steles, like Eosphorus did just moments ago.
units.displayText: Hesperus looks towards the steles, like Eosphorus did just moments ago.

spans.text: Hesperus looks towards the steles, like Eosphorus did just moments ago.

units.rawText: <color=orange>He would've said that, once upon a time.</color>
units.displayText: He would've said that, once upon a time.

spans.text: He would've said that, once upon a time.

units.rawText: After taking care of the red tape around the ceremony, Hesperus comes to the feet of the steles by his lonesome.
units.displayText: After taking care of the red tape around the ceremony, Hesperus comes to the feet of the steles by his lonesome.

spans.text: After taking care of the red tape around the ceremony, Hesperus comes to the feet of the steles by his lonesome.

units.rawText: The Twilight Acropolis remains bleak, as it always had been. A warm light dawns, placing a veil of dark gold over the stele.
units.displayText: The Twilight Acropolis remains bleak, as it always had been. A warm light dawns, placing a veil of dark gold over the stele.

spans.text: The Twilight Acropolis remains bleak, as it always had been. A warm light dawns, placing a veil of dark gold over the stele.

units.rawText: Unexpectedly, Eosphorus' figure is nowhere to be found.
units.displayText: Unexpectedly, Eosphorus' figure is nowhere to be found.

spans.text: Unexpectedly, Eosphorus' figure is nowhere to be found.

units.rawText: Placing the white flowers in his lap down at the feet of the stele, Hesperus turns to leave, but a familiar voice from behind the steles stops him in his steps.
units.displayText: Placing the white flowers in his lap down at the feet of the stele, Hesperus turns to leave, but a familiar voice from behind the steles stops him in his steps.

spans.text: Placing the white flowers in his lap down at the feet of the stele, Hesperus turns to leave, but a familiar voice from behind the steles stops him in his steps.

units.rawText: Just how long are you going to wait here... My legs are getting numb.
units.displayText: Just how long are you going to wait here... My legs are getting numb.

spans.text: Just how long are you going to wait here... My legs are getting numb.

units.rawText: ...Just a bit longer.
units.displayText: ...Just a bit longer.

spans.text: ...Just a bit longer.

units.rawText: Sigh, I wouldn't have come in the first place if I had known...
units.displayText: Sigh, I wouldn't have come in the first place if I had known...

spans.text: Sigh, I wouldn't have come in the first place if I had known...

units.rawText: Electra, Alcyone...
units.displayText: Electra, Alcyone...

spans.text: Electra, Alcyone...

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: Faced with the two young countenances before him, Hesperus realizes his mistake in speaking the names of the deceased.
units.displayText: Faced with the two young countenances before him, Hesperus realizes his mistake in speaking the names of the deceased.

spans.text: Faced with the two young countenances before him, Hesperus realizes his mistake in speaking the names of the deceased.

units.rawText: ...Sorry, my mistake.
units.displayText: ...Sorry, my mistake.

spans.text: ...Sorry, my mistake.

units.rawText: Wow, it sure is rare to see Lord Hesperus slip up. I must say, both you and Lord Eosphorus are acting a little funny today.
units.displayText: Wow, it sure is rare to see Lord Hesperus slip up. I must say, both you and Lord Eosphorus are acting a little funny today.

spans.text: Wow, it sure is rare to see Lord Hesperus slip up. I must say, both you and Lord Eosphorus are acting a little funny today.

units.rawText: Eucharist considers Hesperus with ample interest, pointing towards a corner of the stele.
units.displayText: Eucharist considers Hesperus with ample interest, pointing towards a corner of the stele.

spans.text: Eucharist considers Hesperus with ample interest, pointing towards a corner of the stele.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, we aren't and never will be the "Electra" and "Alcyone" you speak of.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, we aren't and never will be the "Electra" and "Alcyone" you speak of.

spans.text: Unfortunately, we aren't and never will be the "Electra" and "Alcyone" you speak of.

units.rawText: What you're expecting is all the way up there, in the past.
units.displayText: What you're expecting is all the way up there, in the past.

spans.text: What you're expecting is all the way up there, in the past.

units.rawText: Eucharist!
units.displayText: Eucharist!

spans.text: Eucharist!

units.rawText: Ah, sorry, Big Sis. Was I little too honest? I think all of that standing around must have gotten to me.
units.displayText: Ah, sorry, Big Sis. Was I little too honest? I think all of that standing around must have gotten to me.

spans.text: Ah, sorry, Big Sis. Was I little too honest? I think all of that standing around must have gotten to me.

units.rawText: But I think that some things really just need to be said. You wouldn't like to be called Electra either right, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: But I think that some things really just need to be said. You wouldn't like to be called Electra either right, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: But I think that some things really just need to be said. You wouldn't like to be called Electra either right, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Angelus fails to find any words, Eucharist speaking her thoughts exactly.
units.displayText: Angelus fails to find any words, Eucharist speaking her thoughts exactly.

spans.text: Angelus fails to find any words, Eucharist speaking her thoughts exactly.

units.rawText: ...It is true that you are not those who I used to know.
units.displayText: ...It is true that you are not those who I used to know.

spans.text: ...It is true that you are not those who I used to know.

units.rawText: Electra and Alcyone, both outstanding warriors.
units.displayText: Electra and Alcyone, both outstanding warriors.

spans.text: Electra and Alcyone, both outstanding warriors.

units.rawText: They battled to the end, the honor of the Sanctifiers in their hearts until their last moments.
units.displayText: They battled to the end, the honor of the Sanctifiers in their hearts until their last moments.

spans.text: They battled to the end, the honor of the Sanctifiers in their hearts until their last moments.

units.rawText: I only wish for you to be as exalted as they were while holding onto your sense of self.
units.displayText: I only wish for you to be as exalted as they were while holding onto your sense of self.

spans.text: I only wish for you to be as exalted as they were while holding onto your sense of self.

units.rawText: ...Yes!
units.displayText: ...Yes!

spans.text: ...Yes!

units.rawText: That "honor of the Sanctifiers" stuff again... Ok, I get it.
units.displayText: That "honor of the Sanctifiers" stuff again... Ok, I get it.

spans.text: That "honor of the Sanctifiers" stuff again... Ok, I get it.

units.rawText: Eucharist shrugs, her interest briefly piqued by Hesperus' arrival now dampened.
units.displayText: Eucharist shrugs, her interest briefly piqued by Hesperus' arrival now dampened.

spans.text: Eucharist shrugs, her interest briefly piqued by Hesperus' arrival now dampened.

units.rawText: You stay here and stare at this rock, I guess, Big Sis. I'm off to find something more interesting to do.
units.displayText: You stay here and stare at this rock, I guess, Big Sis. I'm off to find something more interesting to do.

spans.text: You stay here and stare at this rock, I guess, Big Sis. I'm off to find something more interesting to do.

units.rawText: Do pardon me, Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: Do pardon me, Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: Do pardon me, Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: Wait, Eucharist!
units.displayText: Wait, Eucharist!

spans.text: Wait, Eucharist!

units.rawText: She does not heed Angelus' calls, flying towards the main tower without turning back for even a second.
units.displayText: She does not heed Angelus' calls, flying towards the main tower without turning back for even a second.

spans.text: She does not heed Angelus' calls, flying towards the main tower without turning back for even a second.

units.rawText: ...My apologies, Lord Hesperus. Please forgive Eucharist for her insolence.
units.displayText: ...My apologies, Lord Hesperus. Please forgive Eucharist for her insolence.

spans.text: ...My apologies, Lord Hesperus. Please forgive Eucharist for her insolence.

units.rawText: She has been in a foul mood since the ceremony this morning. Something must be on her mind.
units.displayText: She has been in a foul mood since the ceremony this morning. Something must be on her mind.

spans.text: She has been in a foul mood since the ceremony this morning. Something must be on her mind.

units.rawText: Angelus tries to make what verbal amends she can. Her gaze lands upon the white flowers Hesperus placed not a moment ago.
units.displayText: Angelus tries to make what verbal amends she can. Her gaze lands upon the white flowers Hesperus placed not a moment ago.

spans.text: Angelus tries to make what verbal amends she can. Her gaze lands upon the white flowers Hesperus placed not a moment ago.

units.rawText: You are here to offer flowers as well? I did not think we would be here to do the same thing...
units.displayText: You are here to offer flowers as well? I did not think we would be here to do the same thing...

spans.text: You are here to offer flowers as well? I did not think we would be here to do the same thing...

units.rawText: Do you think it strange?
units.displayText: Do you think it strange?

spans.text: Do you think it strange?

units.rawText: No, that's not what I mean.
units.displayText: No, that's not what I mean.

spans.text: No, that's not what I mean.

units.rawText: Normally Lord Eosphorus is the one to appear here. I thought he would have come with you...
units.displayText: Normally Lord Eosphorus is the one to appear here. I thought he would have come with you...

spans.text: Normally Lord Eosphorus is the one to appear here. I thought he would have come with you...

units.rawText: ...I expected him to be here too.
units.displayText: ...I expected him to be here too.

spans.text: ...I expected him to be here too.

units.rawText: But perhaps today, he would not rather appear before his compatriots, or remember of the past after the ceremony.
units.displayText: But perhaps today, he would not rather appear before his compatriots, or remember of the past after the ceremony.

spans.text: But perhaps today, he would not rather appear before his compatriots, or remember of the past after the ceremony.

units.rawText: Compatriots... I see...
units.displayText: Compatriots... I see...

spans.text: Compatriots... I see...

units.rawText: Angelus lowers her eyes, muttering Hesperus' words.
units.displayText: Angelus lowers her eyes, muttering Hesperus' words.

spans.text: Angelus lowers her eyes, muttering Hesperus' words.

units.rawText: Forgive me, Lord Hesperus... but you could tell me of Electra?
units.displayText: Forgive me, Lord Hesperus... but you could tell me of Electra?

spans.text: Forgive me, Lord Hesperus... but you could tell me of Electra?

units.rawText: If it is about her exploits, the system ought to have recorded them.
units.displayText: If it is about her exploits, the system ought to have recorded them.

spans.text: If it is about her exploits, the system ought to have recorded them.

units.rawText: I have perused those already. I wish to know not of the honors she received, but how she was as a person.
units.displayText: I have perused those already. I wish to know not of the honors she received, but how she was as a person.

spans.text: I have perused those already. I wish to know not of the honors she received, but how she was as a person.

units.rawText: ...You are neither Electra or a replacement for her.
units.displayText: ...You are neither Electra or a replacement for her.

spans.text: ...You are neither Electra or a replacement for her.

units.rawText: I know I am not her, but...
units.displayText: I know I am not her, but...

spans.text: I know I am not her, but...

units.rawText: She looks towards the bottom of the stele, her face growing conflicted.
units.displayText: She looks towards the bottom of the stele, her face growing conflicted.

spans.text: She looks towards the bottom of the stele, her face growing conflicted.

units.rawText: As a most familiar stranger, I want to learn about her past, the decisions she once made.
units.displayText: As a most familiar stranger, I want to learn about her past, the decisions she once made.

spans.text: As a most familiar stranger, I want to learn about her past, the decisions she once made.

units.rawText: Perhaps this is the only way I can only find the direction I must go in, as someone different from her.
units.displayText: Perhaps this is the only way I can only find the direction I must go in, as someone different from her.

spans.text: Perhaps this is the only way I can only find the direction I must go in, as someone different from her.

units.rawText: It would appear Eucharist is not the only person with something on her mind.
units.displayText: It would appear Eucharist is not the only person with something on her mind.

spans.text: It would appear Eucharist is not the only person with something on her mind.

units.rawText: Angelus does not deny it, lowering her head and falling silent.
units.displayText: Angelus does not deny it, lowering her head and falling silent.

spans.text: Angelus does not deny it, lowering her head and falling silent.

units.rawText: The Electra I remember is not as perfect as Eosphorus would describe.
units.displayText: The Electra I remember is not as perfect as Eosphorus would describe.

spans.text: The Electra I remember is not as perfect as Eosphorus would describe.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: She has frustrations, much like you do, and occasionally expressed a longing for the outside world.
units.displayText: She has frustrations, much like you do, and occasionally expressed a longing for the outside world.

spans.text: She has frustrations, much like you do, and occasionally expressed a longing for the outside world.

units.rawText: As dutiful as she was as a Greater Sanctifier, she did everything in her power to slack off during training and tended to hide in places only Alcyone knew about, sleeping the day away.
units.displayText: As dutiful as she was as a Greater Sanctifier, she did everything in her power to slack off during training and tended to hide in places only Alcyone knew about, sleeping the day away.

spans.text: As dutiful as she was as a Greater Sanctifier, she did everything in her power to slack off during training and tended to hide in places only Alcyone knew about, sleeping the day away.

units.rawText: I knew of the effort she put in behind the scenes to maintain that degree of laxity, but all of the attitude she showed gave the thoroughly seriously Alcyone a lot of headaches.
units.displayText: I knew of the effort she put in behind the scenes to maintain that degree of laxity, but all of the attitude she showed gave the thoroughly seriously Alcyone a lot of headaches.

spans.text: I knew of the effort she put in behind the scenes to maintain that degree of laxity, but all of the attitude she showed gave the thoroughly seriously Alcyone a lot of headaches.

units.rawText: She would often complain to me and Eosphorus about how troublesome this older sister of hers was, but after the in-the-moment emotions passed, they would be good friends once more... Not unlike you and Eucharist?
units.displayText: She would often complain to me and Eosphorus about how troublesome this older sister of hers was, but after the in-the-moment emotions passed, they would be good friends once more... Not unlike you and Eucharist?

spans.text: She would often complain to me and Eosphorus about how troublesome this older sister of hers was, but after the in-the-moment emotions passed, they would be good friends once more... Not unlike you and Eucharist?

units.rawText: ...Do you miss Electra and the others?
units.displayText: ...Do you miss Electra and the others?

spans.text: ...Do you miss Electra and the others?

units.rawText: Not just them. Each and every name on this stele belongs to someone I was once intimately close with.
units.displayText: Not just them. Each and every name on this stele belongs to someone I was once intimately close with.

spans.text: Not just them. Each and every name on this stele belongs to someone I was once intimately close with.

units.rawText: For Eosphorus and I, they record not only the history of the Sanctifiers, but also a past we shall never have in our hands again.
units.displayText: For Eosphorus and I, they record not only the history of the Sanctifiers, but also a past we shall never have in our hands again.

spans.text: For Eosphorus and I, they record not only the history of the Sanctifiers, but also a past we shall never have in our hands again.

units.rawText: The simulated sundown casts the day's remnant light upon the two, spilling across the white flowers the two brought with them.
units.displayText: The simulated sundown casts the day's remnant light upon the two, spilling across the white flowers the two brought with them.

spans.text: The simulated sundown casts the day's remnant light upon the two, spilling across the white flowers the two brought with them.

units.rawText: ...It is true that I do not speak of it often, but I have never forgotten them.
units.displayText: ...It is true that I do not speak of it often, but I have never forgotten them.

spans.text: ...It is true that I do not speak of it often, but I have never forgotten them.

units.rawText: Clenching a fist as if coming to a resolution, Angelus raises her head, presenting Hesperus with a question.
units.displayText: Clenching a fist as if coming to a resolution, Angelus raises her head, presenting Hesperus with a question.

spans.text: Clenching a fist as if coming to a resolution, Angelus raises her head, presenting Hesperus with a question.

units.rawText: ...Lord Hesperus, might I ask you something?
units.displayText: ...Lord Hesperus, might I ask you something?

spans.text: ...Lord Hesperus, might I ask you something?

units.rawText: In your mind... <color=orange>what is a Sanctifier?</color>
units.displayText: In your mind... what is a Sanctifier?

spans.text: In your mind...
what is a Sanctifier?

units.rawText: Nascent life entwines with death here, burning the image into the mind of everyone present.
units.displayText: Nascent life entwines with death here, burning the image into the mind of everyone present.

spans.text: Nascent life entwines with death here, burning the image into the mind of everyone present.

units.rawText: I do not know whether or not my answer that day quelled the uncertainties in her heart. For that reason, I still ponder that question, even now.
units.displayText: I do not know whether or not my answer that day quelled the uncertainties in her heart. For that reason, I still ponder that question, even now.

spans.text: I do not know whether or not my answer that day quelled the uncertainties in her heart. For that reason, I still ponder that question, even now.

units.rawText: In the flame-consumed ruins, a man rises to his feet, ending a brief reminiscence.
units.displayText: In the flame-consumed ruins, a man rises to his feet, ending a brief reminiscence.

spans.text: In the flame-consumed ruins, a man rises to his feet, ending a brief reminiscence.

units.rawText: "What is a Sanctifier"...
units.displayText: "What is a Sanctifier"...

spans.text: "What is a Sanctifier"...

units.rawText: If I were to you pose to you that question... What would be your answer, Eosphorus?
units.displayText: If I were to you pose to you that question... What would be your answer, Eosphorus?

spans.text: If I were to you pose to you that question... What would be your answer, Eosphorus?

units.rawText: The man he points his blade at does not respond, staring down upon the square like he once did in memory.
units.displayText: The man he points his blade at does not respond, staring down upon the square like he once did in memory.

spans.text: The man he points his blade at does not respond, staring down upon the square like he once did in memory.

units.rawText: But unlike those days of memory, there are no allies Hesperus would put his life in the hands of to be seen.
units.displayText: But unlike those days of memory, there are no allies Hesperus would put his life in the hands of to be seen.

spans.text: But unlike those days of memory, there are no allies Hesperus would put his life in the hands of to be seen.

units.rawText: The uproar of the Entropic horde takes the place of that days' chanting, rampantly desecrating the holy ground, wiping away the beauties that once were.
units.displayText: The uproar of the Entropic horde takes the place of that days' chanting, rampantly desecrating the holy ground, wiping away the beauties that once were.

spans.text: The uproar of the Entropic horde takes the place of that days' chanting, rampantly desecrating the holy ground, wiping away the beauties that once were.

units.rawText: ...No, never mind. Pay it no mind, I'm merely talking to myself.
units.displayText: ...No, never mind. Pay it no mind, I'm merely talking to myself.

spans.text: ...No, never mind. Pay it no mind, I'm merely talking to myself.

units.rawText: If you are not stopped here, the Sanctifiers will cease to be soon enough.
units.displayText: If you are not stopped here, the Sanctifiers will cease to be soon enough.

spans.text: If you are not stopped here, the Sanctifiers will cease to be soon enough.

units.rawText: A colossal amount of operands emerges as he finishes speaking, like a flame bursting forth.
units.displayText: A colossal amount of operands emerges as he finishes speaking, like a flame bursting forth.

spans.text: A colossal amount of operands emerges as he finishes speaking, like a flame bursting forth.

units.rawText: In but a moment, the Entropics in Hesperus' vicinity pay the price for their audacity, burnt to a crisp in the soundless acrimony.
units.displayText: In but a moment, the Entropics in Hesperus' vicinity pay the price for their audacity, burnt to a crisp in the soundless acrimony.

spans.text: In but a moment, the Entropics in Hesperus' vicinity pay the price for their audacity, burnt to a crisp in the soundless acrimony.

units.rawText: He draws his blade, cleaving apart the flames with his personage.
units.displayText: He draws his blade, cleaving apart the flames with his personage.

spans.text: He draws his blade, cleaving apart the flames with his personage.

units.rawText: <color=red>Come, Eosphorus. I shall be your foe.</color>
units.displayText: Come, Eosphorus. I shall be your foe.

spans.text: Come, Eosphorus. I shall be your foe.
